item.heading: APPENDIX E BURLINGTON INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT RULES AND REGULATIONS

records.html:
1

Editor’s note—Appendix E to the Burlington Code of Ordinances sets out the Burlington International Airport Rules and Regulations adopted Oct. 25, 1993. These rules and regulations have been treated as superseding similar provisions derived from a resolution of July 20, 1992.

Cross reference—Airports and aircraft, Ch. 3.
